problem: Obligation requires target names and run counts visible in raw logs. Moon task invoked cargo fuzz run -- -runs=1 for all four targets (confirmed by .run.err 'Running' lines), but stdout redirect files are all 0B. No libFuzzer output (run count, seed info, exit summary) is captured.
raw_evidence: yaml_events.run.log: 0B; yaml_events.run.err: 'Running target/x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu/release/yaml_events -runs=1 ...' (same pattern for ipc_frame, journal_event, compiled_ir)
root_cause: Moon task script redirects stdout to .run.log and stderr to .run.err. libFuzzer writes to stderr by default, so .run.log stays empty. Post-run cat only shows cargo output, not libFuzzer output.
required_fix: Change line 355 of .moon/tasks/all.yml fuzz-smoke script from: cargo fuzz run ... >.run.log 2>.run.err  to: cargo fuzz run ... >.run.log 2>&1  (or use tee to capture both streams). This captures libFuzzer stderr in .run.log so run counts are visible in raw evidence.
